questions.question: Estimate the proportion of unstructured data in real-world analytics compared to structured data.
questions.solution_html:
• Demonstrate how data anonymization can protect sensitive information
  • during analysis?
  • Data anonymization is an ethical consideration in data analytics used to protect privacy by
  • ensuring individuals cannot be identified from the data.
  • Techniques
  • Masking/Encryption: Replacing sensitive identifying fields (like names or IDs) with fake or
  • encrypted values.
  • Generalization: Replacing specific values with a broader category (e.g., replacing a specific
  • age with an age range like '20-30').
  • Swapping: Exchanging attributes between different records, which maintains the overall
  • statistical properties but breaks the link to specific individuals.
  • Protection: By removing or obscuring personally identifiable information (PII)
  • anonymization allows for data to be used for manipulation and analysis without violating
  • privacy regulations.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: privacy regulations.

  • o Data Errors: Often, they indicate genuine data entry errors or measurement

questions.question: Describe importance of Data Transformation in data analysis.
questions.solution_html:
• Data transformation is the process of converting data from one format or structure to another
  • often involving steps like Data Cleaning.
  • Importance
  • o Compatibility: Ensures the data is in the correct format for the specific
  • analytical tools or algorithms being used.
  • o Data Quality: Improves quality by reducing inconsistencies, redundancies, and
  • improving overall accuracy.
  • o Normalization/Scaling: Ensures all variables are on a similar scale, preventing
  • features with larger values from dominating the analysis.
  • o Feature Engineering: Creates new, more insightful variables (features) from the
  • existing data, which significantly improves the performance of predictive
  • models.
